title: South Idaho Witness Records Potential UFO Nov 23 , Also Seen Out Of State
excerpt: A Twin Falls resident recorded what might be a UFO Monday night.
content:
A video shared to social media Monday night by a witness in Southern Idaho is slowly racking up thousands of views. The footage appears to show multiple low-altitude crafts maneuvering up and down and emitting white lights.

A video titled 'Twin Falls, Idaho Area Nov 23 UFO?' was shared to Meta Monday at 10:30 P.M. by a witness named Joshua. To date, the post has been viewed over 13,000 times. Other people attached recordings to the original post that show similar objects, with one report coming from west of Toronto, Canada, more than 3,300 miles to the east.

Cluster Of UAPs Recorded Monday Night Over Twin Falls, Idaho

The witness didn't make the footage embeddable, so to view Monday night's reported UFO, click here. The entire video is just 26 seconds long, but it does appear to have impressed some viewers.

'Cool, and keep watching; you will see them again sometimes they’re busier,' said one responder to the footage.

'Weird, I saw 2 yellow orbs this morning on my way to Minidoka. Like 4 am this morning. I told the whole crew,' posted another Idaho resident.

'Saw the same thing in PA the other day. No idea what they are, ' continued another.

Others attempted to debunk the footage.

'Life flight helicopter. Flies over my house all the time,' commented another.
